title: Concept: document.write with a variable
description: A document.write call that takes a variable in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: document.write parses its argument as HTML, and when the value carries request data it becomes live markup in the page's origin.
applicability: Legacy front ends, analytics snippets and third-party widgets.
risk: A reflected value into document.write is a direct script-execution path.
